comrade means a friend who is frequently in the company of another. Example: drinking companions
husband means a married man; a woman's partner in marriage.
officer means any person in the armed services who holds a position of authority or command. Example: an officer is responsible for the lives of his men
patient means a person who requires medical care. Example: the number of emergency patients has grown rapidly
soldier means an enlisted man or woman who serves in an army. Example: the soldiers stood at attention
student means a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution.
nothing means a quantity of no importance. Example: it looked like nothing I had ever seen before
percent means a proportion in relation to a whole (which is usually the amount per hundred).
problem means a state of difficulty that needs to be resolved. Example: she and her husband are having problems
morning means the time period between dawn and noon. Example: I spent the morning running errands
century means a period of 100 years.
improve means to make better. Example: The editor improved the manuscript with his changes
compare means examine and note the similarities or differences of. Example: John compared his haircut to his friend's
believe means accept as true; take to be true. Example: I believed his report
suggest means make a proposal, declare a plan for something. Example: the senator proposed to abolish the sales tax
explain means make plain and comprehensible. Example: He explained the laws of physics to his students
express means give expression to. Example: She showed her disappointment
mention means make reference to. Example: His name was mentioned in connection with the invention
discuss means to consider or examine in speech or writing. Example: The author talks about the different aspects of this question
feed means provide as food. Example: Feed the guests the nuts
imagine means form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case. Example: Can you conceive of him as the president?
produce means bring forth or yield. Example: The tree would not produce fruit
receive means get something; come into possession of. Example: receive payment
provide means give something useful or necessary to. Example: We provided the room with an electrical heater
prevent means keep from happening or arising; make impossible. Example: My sense of tact forbids an honest answer
force means to cause to do through pressure or necessity, by physical, moral or intellectual means :. Example: She forced him to take a job in the city
achieve means to gain with effort. Example: she achieved her goal despite setbacks
attempt means make an effort or attempt. Example: He tried to shake off his fears
require means require as useful, just, or proper. Example: It takes nerve to do what she did
contain means include or contain; have as a component. Example: A totally new idea is comprised in this paper
include means have as a part, be made up out of. Example: The list includes the names of many famous writers
concern means be relevant to. Example: There were lots of questions referring to her talk
involve means connect closely and often incriminatingly. Example: This new ruling affects your business
complete means having every necessary or normal part or component or step. Example: a complete meal
dominant means exercising influence or control. Example: television plays a dominant role in molding public opinion
